copilotUsageBars.refreshMinutes.description: How often to poll Copilot quota.

copilotUsageBars.quotaKey.description: Key in quota_snapshots to track. Falls back to the first limited non-chat/completions snapshot if absent. See the log for available keys.

copilotUsageBars.bankHolidayRegion.description: UK region whose bank holidays are excluded from working days.

copilotUsageBars.extraDaysOff.description: Extra days off excluded from working days. Each entry is YYYY-MM-DD or START/END (YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD). Edited via the Add/Remove Days Off commands.

copilotUsageBars.githubScopes.description: GitHub OAuth scopes requested from VS Code's built-in GitHub sign-in.
